name: Usal
title: Descendant of Shem
summary: Usal was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem through Eber. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the table of nations after the Flood. His name is traditionally linked to an area on the Arabian Peninsula, possibly Sanaa in Yemen.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Table of Nations
keyEvents.description: Usal is listed as one of the thirteen sons of Joktan in the post-flood Table of Nations, which describes the origins of various peoples.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Joktan and Their Settlements
keyEvents.description: Joktan's sons, including Usal, settled in the mountainous region to the east, from Mesha to Sephar. This indicates the geographical spread of these groups.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Usal is mentioned again in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place in Shem's lineage through Joktan.

keyEvents.title: Shem's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Usal is part of Shem's lineage through Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, and Joktan, placing him within the post-flood family history.

keyEvents.title: Possible trade connection with Tyre
keyEvents.description: The name Usal (or a variant) is mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy about Tyre in connection with trade, where it refers to goods from this area.
